function Adapter.new(moduleRoot,context)

end
function Adapter:IsAvailable()
 return not self.failure and workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")~=nil and workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFLobby")~=nil
end
function Adapter:Start()
 if self.started then return end self.started=true
 self.manager:Initialize()
 workspace:SetAttribute("CTFRoundLoopCount",(workspace:GetAttribute("CTFRoundLoopCount") or 0)+1)
 self.thread=task.spawn(function()
  local ok,err=xpcall(function()
   while self.started do
    repeat self.manager:RunIntermission() until self.manager:GameReady()
    self.manager:StopIntermission() self.manager:StartRound()
    repeat self.manager:Update() task.wait() until self.manager:RoundOver()
    self.manager:RoundCleanup()
   end
  end,debug.traceback)
  if not ok then self.failure=tostring(err) workspace:SetAttribute("CTFRuntimeError",self.failure) warn(self.failure) end
 end)
end
local function waitReady(player,context,mode)
 local deadline=os.clock()+12
 repeat
  if not player.Parent or context:GetMode(player)~=mode then return false,"A entrada foi interrompida." end
  if player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady") then return true end
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>deadline
 return false,"O personagem não ficou pronto. Tente novamente."
end
function Adapter:Enter(player)
 if not self:IsAvailable() then return false,"Protótipo CTF indisponível." end
 self.context:SetMode(player,"ctf") self.players:Spawn(player)
 return waitReady(player,self.context,"ctf")
end

 local character=player.Character
 if character then self.flags:DropCarrier(character) self.damage:Unwatch(character) end
 self.voting:RemovePlayer(player)
 self.players:LeaveMatch(player)

end

local Balance = {}
local defaults = {
 BotKillXP = 50, TrainingKillXP = 10,
 ArenaKillXP = 100, ArenaHeadshotXP = 50, ArenaKillCoins = 20,
 CTFKillXP = 70, CTFKillCoins = 15, CTFCaptureXP = 250, CTFCaptureCoins = 60,
}
local values={}
local snapshot
local ok, result = pcall(function() return game:GetService("ConfigService"):GetConfigAsync() end)
if ok then
 snapshot = result
 snapshot.UpdateAvailable:Connect(function()
  local refreshed, err = pcall(function() snapshot:Refresh() end)
  if refreshed then values={} end
  if not refreshed then warn("Crossgrounds reward config refresh: " .. tostring(err)) end
 end)
end
function Balance.Get(key)
 local fallback = assert(defaults[key], "Unknown reward " .. tostring(key))
 if values[key]~=nil then return values[key] end
 if snapshot then
  local success, value = pcall(function() return snapshot:GetValue("Crossgrounds" .. key) end)
  if success and typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value <= 100000 then
   values[key]=math.floor(value)
   return values[key]
  end
 end
 values[key]=fallback
 return fallback
end
return Balance

local Service = {}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Balance = require(script.Parent.ProgressionBalance)
local Policy = require(script.Parent.ProgressionPolicy)
local store = game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("CrossgroundsProgression_v1")
local fields = {"XP","Coins","Kills","Deaths","Captures","PlaySeconds","BotKills","TrainingKills"}
local savedFriends={}
local state = {}
local friendRate = {}
local function blank()
 local result = {}
 for _, key in fields do result[key] = 0 end
 return result
end
local function clean(source)
 local result = blank()
 if type(source) == "table" then
  for _, key in fields do
   local value = source[key]
   if type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 then result[key] = math.floor(math.min(value, 2^50)) end
  end
 end
 return result
end
local function level(xp)
 return math.floor((xp / 250) ^ (1 / 1.45)) + 1
end
local function publish(player, record)
 if not player.Parent then return end
 for _, key in fields do player:SetAttribute("Progress"..key, record.base[key] + record.pending[key]) end
 player:SetAttribute("ProgressLevel", level(record.base.XP + record.pending.XP))
 player:SetAttribute("ProgressionReady", record.loaded)
end
local function award(player, amounts)
 local record = state[player]
 if not record then return end
 for key, value in pairs(amounts) do
  if record.pending[key] and type(value) == "number" and value > 0 then
   record.pending[key] += math.floor(value)
  end
 end
 publish(player, record)
end
function Service.Kill(player,kind,headshot)
 local amounts=Policy.Reward(kind,headshot)
 award(player,amounts)
 return amounts.XP
end
function Service.ArenaDeath(player) award(player,{Deaths=1}) end
function Service.ArenaKill(player,headshot) return Service.Kill(player,"arena",headshot) end
function Service.CTFKill(player,isBot) return Service.Kill(player,isBot and "bot" or "ctf",false) end
local function save(player)
 local record = state[player]
 if not record or not record.loaded or record.saving or RunService:IsStudio() or player.UserId <= 0 then return end
 local delta = {}
 local dirty = false
 for _, key in fields do delta[key] = record.pending[key] if delta[key] > 0 then dirty = true end end
 if not dirty and record.visitSaved then return end
 record.saving = true
 local ok, saved = pcall(function()
  return store:UpdateAsync("u" .. player.UserId, function(previous)
   local merged = clean(previous)
   for _, key in fields do merged[key] += delta[key] end
   merged.HasPlayed=true
   return merged
  end)
 end)
 if ok then
  record.visitSaved=true
  record.base = clean(saved)
  for _, key in fields do record.pending[key] = math.max(0, record.pending[key] - delta[key]) end
  publish(player, record)
 else
  warn("Crossgrounds progression save: " .. tostring(saved))
 end
 record.saving = false
end
local function watchStats(player, record, folder)
 if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") or record.watched[folder] then return end
 record.watched[folder] = true
 local map = {
  Deaths = {Deaths = 1},
  Captures = {XP = "CTFCaptureXP", Coins = "CTFCaptureCoins", Captures = 1},
 }
 for name, rule in pairs(map) do
  local value = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
  if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then
   local previous = value.Value
   table.insert(record.connections, value.Changed:Connect(function(newValue)
    local gained = math.max(0, newValue - previous)
    previous = newValue
    if gained == 0 or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") ~= "ctf" then return end
    local amounts = {}
    for key, amount in pairs(rule) do
     amounts[key] = type(amount) == "string" and Balance.Get(amount) * gained or amount * gained
    end
    award(player, amounts)
   end))
  end
 end
end
local function added(player)
 if state[player] then return end
 local record = {base = blank(), pending = blank(), loaded = false, saving = false, watched = {}, connections = {}}

 if Context:GetMode(player)=="arena" or Context:GetMode(player)=="get_out" then return end
 if not Context:IsCTF(player) then
  Flags:DropCarrier(character) Damage:Unwatch(character) Movement:Reset(player)
  for _,container in {player.Backpack,player.StarterGear,character} do for _,tool in container:GetChildren() do if tool:IsA("Tool") and Kits.Weapons[tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")] then tool:Destroy() end end end
  Context:ApplyHubCharacter(player,character) return
 end
 local hubShield=character:FindFirstChild("HubProtection") if hubShield then hubShield:Destroy() end
 local inArena=running and player:GetAttribute("InMatch")==true
 player:SetAttribute("InArena",inArena)
 character:SetAttribute("AtLobby",not inArena)
 require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.LoadoutService).ApplyPending(player,"ctf")
 Kit:ApplyToCharacter(player,character)
 Movement:ApplyToCharacter(player)
 if inArena and player.Team then Spawn:Place(character,player.Team) else Spawn:Lobby(character) end
 player:SetAttribute("RespawnAt",0)
 Context:MarkReady(player)
end
local function load(player)
 if loading[player] or not player.Parent then return end
 loading[player]=true
 player:SetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady",false)
 local ok,err=pcall(function() player:LoadCharacterAsync() end)
 loading[player]=nil
 if not ok then warn("Character load: "..tostring(err)) end
end
function PlayerManager:Spawn(player)
 player:SetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady",false)
 local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if c and c.Parent and h and h.Health>0 then configure(player,c) else task.spawn(load,player) end
end
local function added(player)
 local stats=Instance.new("Folder") stats.Name="leaderstats" stats.Parent=player
 for _,name in {"Captures","Kills","Deaths"} do local s=Instance.new("IntValue") s.Name=name s.Parent=stats end
 player:SetAttribute("InMatch",false) player:SetAttribute("InArena",false) player:SetAttribute("SelectedKit","Regular")
 player.Neutral=true
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
  local h=c:WaitForChild("Humanoid") c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local function disableDefaultRegen(v) if v.Name=="Health" and v:IsA("BaseScript") then v.Enabled=false end end
  for _,v in c:GetChildren() do disableDefaultRegen(v) end c.ChildAdded:Connect(disableDefaultRegen)
  if not c.Parent then c.AncestryChanged:Wait() end
  task.defer(configure,player,c)
  h.Died:Connect(function()
   if Context:GetMode(player)=="arena" or Context:GetMode(player)=="get_out" then return end
   Flags:DropCarrier(c)
   local delay=player:GetAttribute("InArena") and Config.RESPAWN_TIME or 2
   player:SetAttribute("RespawnAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+delay)
   task.delay(delay,function() if player.Parent and player.Character==c then load(player) end end)
  end)
 end)
 task.spawn(load,player)
end

-- Versioned preferences, using the existing store and update remote.
local Service={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players") local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Definition=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ExperienceSettings) local Controls=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ControlDefinitions)
local Profile=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.PreferenceProfile)
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage.Events local update=events:FindFirstChild("UpdateExperienceSetting") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent",events) update.Name="UpdateExperienceSetting"
local store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("CTF_ExperienceSettings_v1")
local profiles,dirty,revisions,rate,states,connections={},{},{},{},{},{}
local acknowledgements={}
local Policy=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ControlPolicy)
local normalize
local scopes={"Global","Mode:ctf","Mode:arena","Device:Keyboard","Device:Gamepad","Device:Touch"}
local function sync(p)
 local profile=profiles[p] if not profile then return end
 if normalize then normalize(p) end
 local state=states[p]
 for key,rule in Definition.Rules do
  local value=Profile.Resolve(profile,key,p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") or "hub")
  p:SetAttribute("Setting"..key,value)
  if state then for _,scope in scopes do if Definition:Allows(key,scope) then state:SetAttribute(Definition:PreferenceAttribute(key,scope),Profile.Container(profile,scope)[key]) end end end
 end
 if state then
  state:SetAttribute("Revision",revisions[p] or 0)
  -- Profile and acknowledgements arrive atomically; separate attribute echoes
  -- cannot roll a newer client draft back to an earlier request.
  state:SetAttribute("Snapshot",game.HttpService:JSONEncode({version=1,revision=revisions[p] or 0,profile=profile,acks=acknowledgements[p] or {}}))
  state:SetAttribute("Ready",true)
 end
end
local function mark(p,scope,key)
 revisions[p]=(revisions[p] or 0)+1 dirty[p]=dirty[p] or {} dirty[p][scope.."|"..key]=revisions[p]
end
local function set(p,scope,key,value,inherit)
 local profile=profiles[p] if not profile or not Profile.Set(profile,scope,key,value,inherit) then return false end
 mark(p,scope,key) return true
end
local function rebind(p,action,device,name)
 local current={} for id in Controls.Actions do current[id]=Profile.Resolve(profiles[p],Controls:Attribute(id,device),"hub") end
 local plan=Policy.Plan(Controls,current,action,device,name)
 if not plan then return false end
 for id,key in plan do if current[id]~=key then set(p,"Device:"..device,Controls:Attribute(id,device),key) end end
 return true
end
normalize=function(p)
 for _,device in {"Keyboard","Gamepad"} do
  local current={} for id in Controls.Actions do current[id]=Profile.Resolve(profiles[p],Controls:Attribute(id,device),"hub") end
  local plan=Policy.Normalize(Controls,current,device)
  if plan then for id,key in plan do if key~=current[id] then set(p,"Device:"..device,Controls:Attribute(id,device),key) end end end
 end
end
local function save(p)
 if not dirty[p] or not next(dirty[p]) or Run:IsStudio() or p.UserId<=0 then return end
 local captured=Profile.Migrate(profiles[p]) local changes=table.clone(dirty[p]) local newer=false
 local ok=pcall(function() store:UpdateAsync("u"..p.UserId,function(old)
  if typeof(old)=="table" and typeof(old.Version)=="number" and old.Version>Definition.Version then newer=true return nil end
  local merged=Profile.Migrate(old)
  for path in changes do local scope,key=path:match("^(.-)|(.+)$") local value=Profile.Container(captured,scope)[key] Profile.Set(merged,scope,key,value,value==nil) end
  return merged
 end) end)
 if not p.Parent then return end
 p:SetAttribute("SettingsSaveState",newer and "NewerVersion" or ok and "Saved" or "RetryPending")
 if ok and not newer then for path,version in changes do if dirty[p] and dirty[p][path]==version then dirty[p][path]=nil end end end
end
local function added(p)
 profiles[p]=Profile.New() revisions[p]=0 dirty[p]={} acknowledgements[p]={}
 local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui") gui.Name="PreferenceState" gui.ResetOnSpawn=false gui.Enabled=false gui.Parent=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") states[p]=gui
 p:SetAttribute("SettingsPersistence",not Run:IsStudio()) p:SetAttribute("SettingsSaveState",Run:IsStudio() and "StudioSessionOnly" or "Loading") sync(p)
 connections[p]=p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CrossgroundsMode"):Connect(function() sync(p) end)
 if Run:IsStudio() or p.UserId<=0 then return end
 local ok,data=pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u"..p.UserId) end)
 if not p.Parent then return end
 if ok then
  local loaded=Profile.Migrate(data)
  for path in dirty[p] or {} do local scope,key=path:match("^(.-)|(.+)$") local value=Profile.Container(profiles[p],scope)[key] Profile.Set(loaded,scope,key,value,value==nil) end
  profiles[p]=loaded p:SetAttribute("SettingsSaveState","Loaded") sync(p)
 else p:SetAttribute("SettingsSaveState","LoadFailed") end
end
update.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,key,value)
 if typeof(key)~="string" or not profiles[p] then return end
 local now=os.clock() local budget=rate[p]
 if not budget or now-budget.start>=1 then budget={start=now,count=0} rate[p]=budget end
 budget.count+=1 if budget.count>60 then return end
 if key=="PreferenceEdit" then
  if typeof(value)~="table" then return end local count=0 for _ in value do count+=1 if count>5 then return end end
  local scope,field,op,sequence=value.scope,value.key,value.op,value.sequence
  if typeof(scope)~="string" or typeof(field)~="string" or not Definition:Allows(field,scope) then return end
  if sequence~=nil and (typeof(sequence)~="number" or sequence~=sequence or sequence%1~=0 or sequence<1 or sequence>=2147483648) then return end
  local path=scope.."|"..field
  if sequence and sequence<=(acknowledgements[p][path] or 0) then return end
  if op=="set" then
   local rule=Definition.Rules[field]
   if rule.Device then if not rebind(p,rule.Action,rule.Device,value.value) then return end
   else set(p,scope,field,value.value) end
  elseif op=="inherit" then set(p,scope,field,nil,true)
  elseif op=="default" then set(p,scope,field,Definition.Rules[field].Default)
  else return end
  if sequence then acknowledgements[p][path]=sequence end
 elseif key=="PreferenceReset" then
  if typeof(value)~="table" or typeof(value.scope)~="string" or typeof(value.category)~="string" then return end
  local count=0 for _ in value do count+=1 if count>4 then return end end
  local sequence=value.sequence
  if sequence~=nil and (typeof(sequence)~="number" or sequence~=sequence or sequence%1~=0 or sequence<1 or sequence>=2147483648) then return end
  for field,rule in Definition.Rules do if (value.category=="All" or rule.Category==value.category) and Definition:Allows(field,value.scope) then
   local path=value.scope.."|"..field
   if not sequence or sequence>(acknowledgements[p][path] or 0) then
    set(p,value.scope,field,rule.Default,value.inherit==true)
    if sequence then acknowledgements[p][path]=sequence end
   end
  end end
 elseif key=="ResetControls" and (value==true or value=="Keyboard" or value=="Gamepad") then
  for action,data in Controls.Actions do for _,device in {"Gamepad","Keyboard"} do if value==true or value==device then set(p,"Device:"..device,Controls:Attribute(action,device),data[device]) end end end
 elseif key=="MobileHUDLayout" then
  if typeof(value)~="table" then return end local clean={} local count,expected=0,0
  for _,rule in Definition.Rules do if rule.MobileLayout then expected+=1 end end
  for field,number in value do
   count+=1 if count>expected or typeof(field)~="string" then return end
   local rule=Definition.Rules[field] if not rule or not rule.MobileLayout then return end
   local valid=Definition:Sanitize(field,number) if valid==nil then return end clean[field]=valid
  end
  if count~=expected then return end for field,number in clean do set(p,"Device:Touch",field,number) end
 else
  local rule=Definition.Rules[key] if not rule then return end
  local clean=Definition:Sanitize(key,value) if clean==nil then return end
  local scope=rule.PreferenceDevice and "Device:"..rule.PreferenceDevice or "Global"
  if rule.Device then
   if not rebind(p,rule.Action,rule.Device,clean) then return end
  else set(p,scope,key,clean) end
 end
 sync(p) p:SetAttribute("SettingsSaveState",Run:IsStudio() and "StudioSessionOnly" or "Pending")
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
 save(p) if connections[p] then connections[p]:Disconnect() end
 profiles[p]=nil dirty[p]=nil revisions[p]=nil rate[p]=nil states[p]=nil connections[p]=nil acknowledgements[p]=nil
end)
for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(added,p) end
task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(30) for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do save(p) end end end)
game:BindToClose(function() for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do save(p) end end)
